description: Retentionsflächen Überschwemmung BB is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo.brandenburg.de. The data set contains data from the LBGR on the retention areas flooding Brandenburg and is provided via a presentation and download service. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Retention areas Flood BB" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Cobalt, bboxbebb, Chrom III, Mangan, Blei, Quecksilber. The listing shows 2007-12-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
